youtube.title: Why Do Mirrors Flip Left And Right? 🪞 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A flat mirror reverses an image front-to-back, along the axis perpendicular to the glass, not left-to-right. Each point appears directly opposite itself. We read it as a left-right swap because we imagine turning around to stand where the reflection is.
